Talk title: Postgres at 40k Writes/sec Without Losing Sleep
Speaker: Nadia Farouk
Abstract: What actually broke when we pushed a single Postgres primary to 40k writes per second: connection pooling, WAL pressure, autovacuum tuning, and the two things we got wrong for six months.

Talk title: Design Systems That Survive a Rebrand
Speaker: Theo Lindqvist
Abstract: A rebrand usually means rewriting every component. It should mean changing thirty tokens. How we restructured ours so the second rebrand took four days instead of four months.

Talk title: Incident Review as a Product Skill
Speaker: Amara Osei
Abstract: Postmortems get written and never read. We turned ours into a ten-minute recurring product ritual and started catching the same class of bug before it shipped.

Talk title: Shipping ML Features Without an ML Team
Speaker: Ruben Costa
Abstract: A hands-on workshop on getting a useful model into production using managed services only: evaluation harness first, model second, and how to know when to stop.
